recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Any remaining IG Publisher behavior issue should be handled in IG Publisher/package tooling, while FHIR core package documentation should continue to follow the later /package/example guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-23043 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked to document that IG Publisher packages put ImplementationGuide-marked examples in an "example" directory sibling to the "package" directory, explicitly noting that this applied to IGs rather than the core spec.
initial_application: No Jira-tagged FHIR-23043 source commit was found. The linked Zulip thread shows the request arose from 2019 FHIR NPM package tooling/documentation discussion, and the Jira later says it was deferred because it was for Confluence rather than direct spec source. The source/packages.html page was added later by an untagged package documentation commit.
additional_context: FHIR-27832, a later Published/Persuasive package-spec correction, states that the sibling-to-package examples-folder practice was abandoned to comply with NPM and that additional folders should be under package. The combined branch already contains the FHIR-27832 reconciliation commit, and current source/packages.html uses /package/example.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit and left source unchanged. Reintroducing FHIR-23043's sibling-directory wording would conflict with FHIR-27832 and with the current build-scoped package page.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive correction supersedes the sibling-folder aspect of FHIR-23043 by requiring package example folders below package and clarifying JSON examples.
